payload.focus: Sprint retro: async decision widget shipped, velocity 23 points highest this quarter, Zephyr integration as key unlock
payload.rationale: This sprint retro (dated 2026-10-01) echoes the prior Sprint 4 Retro (2026-03-22) almost verbatim — same async decision widget, same 23-point velocity, same Zephyr integration as key unlock — so the passes need the full prior retro context to detect duplication or evolution. I expanded the anti-Slack positioning narrative and its children (anti-pattern real-time chat, product category, target market, pricing tiers) because the widget's value proposition is framed against Slack. I surfaced the decision-capture-at-consensus and decisions-evaporate narratives since the widget embodies both. The webhook architecture and Zephyr rate-limit resolution positions explain the technical unlock Tanya names. The metric-anchor style observation is included because the document uses the same quantified-claim register. I did not expand the Thematic or People doors since the perspective already surfaced all relevant nodes and no additional axes or participants exist beyond Tanya.
